item.description:
Asobi 1.0 (build 2186) Nov 9, 2026

  • Bring Back knows who said it. Frame.io doesn't give the names of guests on a share, so Asobi reads them off the share's own page: notes now say Art or Madeline, not Frame.io. Bring Back again to put names on comments brought back before.
  • The agency's drawings come back as marks on the frame they drew on.
  • Also post them to Kitsu now puts each comment once on its shot's Compositing task, with the drawn frame attached and the status kept, as well as in its agency notes.
  • The Progress view shows the agency's latest comments under the shot on screen, a count on the others, and an Agency chip to show them on every shot.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 2175) Nov 6, 2026

  • Movies no longer look lifted on a Mac. A reel or clip made for a Rec.709 screen is now tagged gamma 2.4, the curve the viewer shows, so QuickTime Player, Finder and Safari show it as the review looked. Before, mid-grey came up from 128 to 145. The pixels are the same; only the tag changed.
  • Choose the cuts in a Whole Session Reel. The save dialog lists each cut with a box. A grade or edit reference (Grade or Ref in its name) starts unticked, so the movie you matched against stays out. The session remembers your choice.

1.0 (build 2172) Nov 6, 2026

  • Color, Media and Conform, sorted by the job. Each menu groups what you're doing under a small heading (Color: Grade, Match the color, Versions, LUTs and CDLs; Conform: Bring in a cut, Edit the shots, Edit Ref, Send it out, Plates), and every command has one home. The Playlist's right-click menus follow the same groups.
  • Set Kitsu Shot. Which Kitsu shot a shot is (it was Match Shots to Kitsu), from a shot's right-click or Conform ▸ Edit the shots. "Match" now always means color: Match Color to ▸.
  • One Split at Playhead, one Join with Next Shot, for any shot, whether it came from a cut file or a movie.

1.0 (build 2165) Nov 6, 2026

  • LUTs carry a shot's whole color. Generate LUTs now bakes each shot's grade, looks and match together, for every shot with a correction or a match. The index says what each holds.
  • Use a shot's LUT again. Each generated LUT is kept with its shot. In a new conform, right-click the movie ▸ Use Each Shot's Latest LUT (or one clip ▸ Use Shot's Latest LUT) and each shot takes its own.

1.0 (build 2162) Nov 5, 2026

  • Progress notes in the Notes column. A new Progress view lists a movie's or a Kitsu playlist's shots with their progress notes, filtered by submission date, so the last round reads at a glance and today's goes in beside it. Notes can be edited in place. They are the Kura Hub Shot Tracker's progress notes.
  • Review notes into progress notes. Right-click a note ▸ Add to Progress Notes, or Send All to Progress Notes… from the Notes header. Settings ▸ Interface can send notes you type on a Kitsu shot straight to its progress notes (on by default).
  • Match one shot's color to another. Right-click a shot ▸ Match to, or a movie's header ▸ Match Every Shot to another cut: each shot is fitted to the same shot in the other cut, lined up in time, with no conform. Matches are kept with the shot in 03_SHOTS.
  • Generate LUTs for a shot or every shot (right-click, or the Color menu): each shot's match as its own .cube, with an index.

1.0 (build 2152) Nov 5, 2026

  • Report a problem from Asobi. Help ▸ Report a Problem… sends a report or a suggestion to the studio's bug tracker, with pictures (grab Asobi's window or a panel, paste or drop one, and mark it up), a voice note, or a short recording of what you did. Help ▸ My Reports shows each one's status and the reply. A report that can't be sent waits and goes later.
  • Drop clips into someone else's review. Dropped on the playlist (or Review ▸ Add Clips to the Review…), they go straight into the review for everyone.
  • New clips reach everyone fast. Studio Macs open the original within seconds. Macs elsewhere and the web link wait for the clip's review copy, saying how far along it is, and go to it when it's ready.
  • Resync. Catch Up with the Room is now Review ▸ Resync. The host has Review ▸ Resync Viewers, and the web link has its own Resync button.
  • Compare with Plate in someone else's review now shows for everyone.

1.0 (build 2140) Nov 5, 2026

  • Catch Up with the Room. In someone else's review, Review ▸ Catch Up with the Room (or a right-click on the Live chip) takes you to the host's clip and frame at once, with any clips added since you joined.
  • Reviews stay in step. Every few seconds the host tells the room where it is. A Mac that has ended up on another clip, or stopped on another frame, goes back by itself.
  • The host's file, not just its name. A clip found by name must also match the host's file. If your Mac holds another file under the same name, Asobi switches to the host's when it can see it, and tells you when it can't.
  • Add Clips to the Review… A studio Mac in someone else's review can put clips into it. An internal review takes them straight in; otherwise the host is asked first.

1.0 (build 2136) Nov 4, 2026

  • Kitsu playlists play the version they name. A shot with the same version number on two tasks, such as a generative v006 and a comp v006, could play the one downloaded first. Each task's versions now keep their own file, and their name says the task.
